भन्दिल n. (-लं) Good, happiness, welfare, prosperity.
 2. Tremulous mo-
tion.
 m. (-लः) A messenger.
 E. भदि to be auspicious, Unādi aff.
इलच् ।

भान n. (-नं) The act of growing visible.
 2. Light, lustre.
 3. Perception.
 E. भा, ल्युट् aff.

. A ray of light.
 4. A master.
 5.
A sovereign, a prince.
 6. The father of the fifteenth Jaina pontiff.
7.

. A day.
 9. An epithet of ŚIVA.
 f. (-नुः) A handsome
woman.
 E. भा to shine, Unādi aff. नु ।

भानुफला f. (-ला) The plantain, (Musa sapientum.)
 E. भानु the sun, फल
the fruit; being offered in the worship of the sun.

भानुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
 1. Luminous, splendid, resplendent.
 2.
Beautiful, handsome.
 m. (-मान्) The sun.
 E. भानु light, मतुप्
poss. aff.

भानुवार m. (-रः) Sunday.
 E. भानु the sun and वार a day.

भानेमि m. (-मिः) The sun.
 E. भा light, नेमि circumference. “अर्कवृक्षेच ।”
